title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale in Straus Square
description_en: The apartment is located in an existing building on the 5th floor. It has a view of Straus square and natural light all the time. It has a net area in certificates of 71.5m2. It is organized: A living room with a kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with a window, 1 balcony, and a distribution corridor. It has ownership certificates.
